༄༅/ /rje btsan bye lan gyi lo rgyus dang gsol mchod bya tshul lha gling gi cong sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje btsan bye lan gyi lo rgyus dang gsol mchod bya tshul lha gling gi cong sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

byams pa dang snying rje chen pos sdug bsngal dang dka' ba las skyob pa yangs pa'i byin rlabs can byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// ngo mtshar brjod med byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs// du ma'i bskal par goms pas zhi zhing gzi brjid pa// so gnyis sprul pas srid pa'i khams dang bstun zhing 'jug /sdug bsngal mtsho las 'gro rnams rtag tu grus sgrol ba// nyid dang 'phags pa'i skyes bus bka' lung nod// rngam brjid rlung dang thog bzhin do zlas dben// bstan pa'i srung ma mthu chen bye lan mtshan// mchod pa'i cho ga lha gling cong sgra bya// 'dir bstan srung chen po bye lan nam kon yus drang du 'bod pa'i gsol mchod bya tshul la gnyis/ srung ma chen po'i lo rgyus dang*/ de la gsol mchod bya tshul dngos bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ sngon gyi dus su ma hā tsi na'i yul gru chen por/ rgyal rabs han gyi blon po grags can rus kon dang ming yus zhes bya ba dpa' mdzangs brtul phod pa zhig byung*/ mthu stobs shin tu che ba'i dmag dpon mdzad de yul gru tha dad pa'i dgra bo ma rungs pa rnams tshar bcad nas ljongs kyi rgyal po dang rgyal phran grangs las 'das pa mnga' 'og tu btsud/ dpa' rtsal gyis snyems pa rnams kyang 'di'i gam du slebs na/ khyung chen dang byi'u'i rtsal lta bur gyur pas yul phyogs kun tu 'di'i ming thos pa tsam gyis mi 'dud pa gcig kyang med/ de yang skyong 'os dang 'dul dgos kyi rnam dbye med pa'i dpa' thal lta bu ma yin par zhi drag gi bya ba gang la yang g.yo med drang por byed pa zhig yin skad/ sgros la chos rgyal mya ngan med lta bu sa chen po chos bzhin du skyong ba'i 'khor los sgyur rgyal yin yang blo bur du thugs mug pa'i ngang nas 'das pas nya mid chen po'i skye ba blangs par gsungs pa ltar/ spyir kun slong dang kun spyod la skyon mi mnga' yang zhe khrel gyi ngang du tshe'i dus byas pas hu'u bā'i yi sa'i char/

g.yus jon ri bo'i klu rigs kyi mi ma yin mthu bo che zhig tu gyur nas lo bzhi brgya lhag song ba na/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi lta ba'i brgyud 'dzin then dā'i grub mtha' shing rta chen po ṭī ḍa tāg hri zhes bya ba'i ri der sgrub pa la byon pa na/ yul mi rnams kyis shin tu gnyan pa'i rgyu mtshan smras kyang ma bzlog par ri de'i spyil bu'i nang du yang dag par 'jog pa'i skabs mi ma yin gyi cho 'phrul gyis rnam 'gyur sna tshogs bstan kyang ting nge 'dzin las g.yo bar byed ma nus pas skabs shig na go cha dang rgyan gyis spras pa'i dmag dpon chen po sde brgyad kyi dpung dang bcas pa mngon sum du byung nas/ slob dpon la phyag byas shing mtho 'tshams pa'i tshul gyis nyams sad par bzod gsol zhus/ slob dpon gyis rgyu mtshan rnams dris/ las 'bras kyi chos mang du gsungs nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bogs/ bstan pa'i srung mar bskos shing dge 'dun gyi sde dang chos 'khor skyong bar dam bcas so// de lta bu'i srung ma chen po 'di nyid bod du wun khren kong jo'i rjes su 'brangs pas rdzong btsan bshan pa dang beg rtse lcam sring rnams thugs rgyud gcig par bzhed la/ bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po karma pa sku phreng gnyis pa grub chen pak+shi nas bzung sku phreng lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che chos kyi rgyal po'i bar/ rgya hor gyi gong ma rnams kyi dbu bla mdzad nas dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa ngo mtshar can dpag med mthong chos su bstan pas/ mnga' ris kyi rgyal khams dag la dkar chos kyi mdzad phrin dpe med byung bas dpung dang grogs dan gyi tshul du bkur bar grags pa/ tsi na'i yul gyi bstan srid thun mong ba'i chos skyong bkwan la'o ye zhes/ lo ltar gnam lo gsar tshes kyi tshes gnyis nyin rje karma pa dbu bzhugs thog rgyas brngan gsol mchod zab smin thengs re gnang ste/

rgya bod yul gru kun tu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ mchod yon gyi sku tshe srings/ 'gro ba rnams bde skyid la 'tsho ba'i 'phrin las dbye ba med par sgrub dgos pa'i bka' bsgos dang bsngo smon rgyas 'debs bcas gnang srol yod do// srung ma 'di'i lo rgyus yig cha 'dra min cung zad byung na'ang*/ 'dir bkod pa ni gtso bo thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos nyi'i char rgyun 'brug sgra dang*/ mgon po skyabs kyi rgya nag chos 'byung*/ gzhan yang sngon gyi yi ge khungs thub dag las ji ltar byung ba ltar bkod pa yin pas yid ches pa'i gnas su bzung bar rigs so// gnyis pa/ da ni dgra lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsol mchod bya bar 'dod pa rnams kyi ngor mdo tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i mchod tshogs ci 'byor ba dang*/ bsang mchod sgos su 'bul na bsang shing sna tshogs yang 'du byas la/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ sngags drug phyag drug dang ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis brlabs/ bdag lhar bskyed cing mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ hrīḥ bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs// zhi 'dzum rgyan gyis spras pa'i yid 'ong sku// gangs kyi lhun por dbang zhus bklubs pa 'dra'i// snang stong chu zla lta bur lham mer gsal// dmigs pa dang bcas yi ge drug ma'i bzlas pa ci nus bya/ thugs ka'i sa bon 'od kyi lcags kyu yis// che btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas// thogs med rdzu 'phrul rlung gi shing rtar brten// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir ā kar+ṣ+ya dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ mdog dmar tsan+dan las grub rkang stegs ni// gcan gzan gtum po'i pags pa'i bgo ba can// rin chen khams kyi phra yis nyer mtshan par// 'khor dang bcas pa dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs// mgron gsal 'debs pa ni/ kyai/ 'phags pa lag na ral gris byang chub kyi// spyod pa rgya mtshos byin rlabs tsi na'i yul// g.yon ngos shar gyi rgya mtshos rab bskor zhing*// le dbar khri ldan lcags ris g.yas nas 'khyud// rin chen nor gzhong zhing chen rtsa drug las// mtshe 'u byang mar 'bod pa'i zhing gi char// dge bcu'i mtshan ris bkra ba'i 'dzin ma'i khyon// mdzes par byed pa'i ri bo g.yus jon zhes// bsti gnas skabs gsum grong gi do zla can// rtsa sngon spu sdug 'dzin pa'i ne'u gsing ngos// dal 'gro'i dril chung snyan pa'i dbyangs 'jo zhing*// tshang tshing nags kyi mdzes pa'i khor yug yangs// snod bcud phyi nang kun tu lha dang mi'i// dpal 'byor mi zad gya nom snang ba yi// ngo mtshar ri yi mchog gyur de nyid dang*// byin rlabs 'od 'bar gnas chen rnam bzhi sogs// gang du bzhugs pa'i bstan srung mthu bo che// che btsan dregs pa'i dbang po bye lan ni// rab brjid bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor dmar ba'i mdangs// 'bar ba'i sma ra og tshom ring zhing gzengs// rgya bya'i spyan mig yon po'i lta stangs kyis// gzigs pa'i smin dkyus rgod gshog lta bur brkyangs// gnam sngon thags su byas 'dra'i mthon mthing gi

/dar gyi la thod cod pan phur mas mdzes// margad khu bas btsos snyam srab mo'i gos// 'jol tshul bklubs shing gcan gzan mgo ris kyi// sra mkhregs go cha dar dpyangs g.yo bas spud// nag po'i rtsa lag sder bcas mthar byed pa'i// phyag g.yas 'brug sngon zla tshes shang lang bsnams// gyi ling g.yang ṭis brgyan pa'i ska rags kyi// logs su rno ngar phun tshogs ral gri dpyangs// rlung gi khengs pa 'phrog pa'i yos dmar rta// mtshams sprin gsar pa g.yo ba lta bu la// rat+na'i sga srab rgyan gyis sgeg pa'i steng*// gser ris l+h+wam gyis sba ba'i zhabs zung rol// lha chen de yi g.yas kyi nye logs na// kon bin zhes bya 'dzum dpal zla ba'i bzhin// 'khyog 'bar me lce g.yo 'dra'i drag gos dang*// dngul dkar go khrab dar dmar la thod bcings// 'gran bral gri chen yu dmar phyag na bsnams// shin tu bslab byas dul zhing brling ba yi// rta mchog seng ge dkar mo lta bu'i steng*// dgra sde 'joms pa'i 'khor gsum sked la btags// lha chen g.yon du stobs ldan bka' nyan ni// kra'u tshang 'jigs rung gzig spyang lta bu'i lus// khrag gi smug rtsis bskus pa'i gdong lag ni// 'char ka'i mdangs ldan gnag pa'i sma ra brjid// lcags kyi glegs bu bsnol ma'i ya lad dang*// rin chen rnga phrus brgyan pa'i cod pan gsol// lag tu 'bigs byed rno lcags mdung ring bzung*// yid kyi rjes su gom pa 'god pa yi// mgyogs 'gro'i dbang po mtshan mo'i gos kyi spun// gzer stan sga srab mdzes pa zhabs su bcibs// mthu chen rdzu 'phrul grub pa rnams kyi gzugs// dwangs pa'i shel la sna tshogs snang ba bzhin// zhi drag las kyi nyams 'gyur mtha' klas phyir// spros pa'i cha lugs ma lus brjod dka' yang*// nyams dga'i gtam gyi rol mo de tsam dkrol// 'khor du kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i lung rtogs bstan// dar rgyas spel dang dkar po dge ba'i las// skyong la dgyes pa'i dga' 'dzum mul le ba// sde brgyad mi min 'byung po mthu chen sogs// gzhan yang mchod sbyin bya bar 'os pa'i mgron// mtshan nas smos kyis ma longs thams cad gsal//

mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ khyed rnams dgyes pa'i thun rdzas 'dod yon lnga// gser dngul rin chen nor bu 'bru sman dar// shis pa'i rtags brgyad rgyal srid rin chen bdun// 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing*// dbang gi mdog can sga srab spras pa'i rta// gzugs 'gros g.yag lug rwa skyes 'dod 'jo'i ba// dkar sum mngar sum phye mar ri ltar spungs// rgya ja myos byed btung ba'i chu gter bskyil// gzhal med pho brang skyed tshal khrus kyi rdzing*// rang phyogs bsrung ba'i go dang rgol 'joms mtshon// gzhan yang lha klu mi yi dkon nor rigs// ngo mtshar 'bum phrag ngom par mi zad pa// spyan gzigs ma tshang med pa 'di dag kun// lha chen 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// bsang mchod sgos su 'bul ba'am/ mnga' gsol 'phrin bcol sogs rgyas pa spro na ni zur gsal bzhin bya zhing*/ rgyun chags su 'phrin las bcol ba'i tshig sngon dus slob dpon blo gros mtshan can sogs// dpal ldan thub pa'i gdung 'tshob grangs med kyis// dam tshig bdud rtsi'i thigs pa snying la brlan// bsgos pa'i bka' lung btsan po rjes dgongs la// bslu med skyabs gsum rin chen gtsug na bsnyen// gzhan don byang chub sgrub pa'i sems mchog bskyed// chos kun stong zhing bdag med don shes na// sdug bsngal kun las grol zhes thub pas gsungs// rgyal dang rgyal bstan snying po dwags brgyud kyi// dri med bshad sgrub lhur len 'dus pa'i sde// shin sbyangs sdom brtson dam pa'i khrims mdzes pas// 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor 'gengs pa'i stong grogs mdzod// rtogs pa don brgyud mos gus lam gcig gi// brgyud 'dzin bu slob dbyar gyi chu ltar rgyas// grub thob brgyud pa'i ri sul kun gang ste// phyag rgya chen po'i ring lugs rgyas par mdzod// rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las rang gzugs ni// srid 'dir rnam par 'dren mchog sprul pa'i sku// dpal ldan karma pa yi sku tshe dang*// mdzad phrin yangs pa'i kha lo khyod kyi bsgyur// bdag cag yon sbyor mi nor 'khor dang bcas// nad dang bgegs rigs dus min 'chi ba dang*// dgra rkun kha mchu byad kyis mi tshugs pa'i// rdo rje'i srung ba'i gur du sba bar mdzod// ring 'tsho'i tshe yi ljon pa rgyas pa'i rtser// bsod nams 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i khrod// bde 'byor sred pas myos pa'i gzhan gsos bu// skyid pa'i ga zha dbyangs su len par mdzod//

de nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ brjid brjid dgra lha'i dbang po kon la'o ye// mtshar mtshar 'khor gyi 'du 'god grangs med bcas// 'dzum 'dzum bzhin gyi zla ba bkra bzhin du// rang rang gnas su bde bar bzhud cig go / bkra shis ni/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan srung ba'i lha// dgyes bskyed gsol mchod bgyis pa'i dge ba yis// 'gro rnams bde legs rgya mtshor spyod pa dang*// kun dga'i dge mtshan 'bar ba'i bkra shis shog / ces nyi ma shar phyogs kyi yul gru chen por mnga' dbang 'gyur ba'i bstan srung chen po rje btsan bye lan du grags pa 'di'i gsol mchod drung na rim gong ma rnams kyi gsung byin rlabs can dag dus dbang gis mi mngon par gyur nas don gnyer can mang pos snga phyir bskul ma yang yang byas pa dang*/ rang la'ang rmi lam sogs mtshan ltas dge bar byung rung*/ deng dus phal mo che zhig gis bstan srung ye shes pa rnams dor nas mi ma yin gdug pa can dag bla ma dkon mchog las lhag pa'i skyabs gnas su 'cha' bas 'di 'dra'i yi ge spel ba dgos pa las dgag bya che na'ang rma la phan na khyi tshil gyi dpe bzhin bstan 'gror sman pa'i phrin las can du mthong nas lo rgyus dang gsol mchod bya tshul lha gling gi cong sgra zhes bya ba 'di nyid ston pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i gnas wā rā ṇa sīr/ karma pa'i mtshan 'dzin bcu bdun pa o rgyan phrin las dpal ldan dbang gi rdo rjes lhag blos sbyar ba bkra shis par gyur cig /smras pa/ phan bde'i gzhi ma thub bstan yid bzhin nor// srid zhi'i bla ru 'degs pa'i spobs pa can// gang zhig yin yang dri med lhag bsam gyis// mchod bstod bkur ba'i 'os su bzung bar rigs// de phyir ma hā tsi na'i yul gru ru// byung ba'i bstan srung 'phrin las thogs med can// bye lan 'khor bcas mchod pa'i cho ga ni// nyung bsdus snyan pa'i cong sgra 'di byas so// dge ba'i rgyun bzang bdud rtsi'i theg phreng ni// bstan 'gro'i rgud mun zhi zhing bde skyid dpal// nam yang nub pa med pa'i ngo mtshar can// ris med 'gro la 'char ba'i rgyu ru bsngo//
